description: The spatial package contains municipal limits, blocks, detailed-plan and urbanization-plan areas, broader zoning, SLAT traffic-analysis zones and slope rasters. Native metadata explicitly identify traffic-analysis zones as inputs for transport modelling and management. GeoJSON, shapefile and Esri-grid components have different geometric purposes; no common spatial resolution or complete harmonized time coverage is assumed. The metadata catalogue lists 2016–2020, while native metadata uses the same interval as its publication-date field. The archive remains unopened, so individual component dates, raster units and geometry validity are unverified. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
